answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 43066 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Can we pray sunnah after the fardh salaat? Question: For the Zuhr prayer is it acceptable to pray the 4 rakah fardh prayer first then afterwards, we pray the 4 rakahs of Sunnah muakkadah? Answer ID: 43066 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 135/114/B=1434) Yes, due to any excuse or problem you may offer fardh salah first and four rakah sunnah later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
